title: 開放ボウル付き綿菓子機
description: 公園売店や催事カウンターに配置する綿菓子機。厚みを持つ広がった金属ボウルと実際の凹んだ内側、中央の固定スピナーヘッド/砂糖口、赤い基台、操作つまみ/スイッチ、四脚ゴム足、裏側吸排気外形と電源口を造形しています。綿菓子・砂糖・棒は付属しません。台上配置用に高さを調整してください。加熱・回転・食品処理を実装した機器設計ではない、静的な一式1点です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.670 × 0.445 × 0.670 m、9,400三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A cotton-candy machine for park concessions and event counters. It has a thick flared metal bowl with genuinely recessed interior, fixed central spinner head and sugar opening, red base, knobs/switches, four rubber feet, rear ventilation exteriors and power inlet. No candy, sugar or sticks are included. Adjust its installation height for a counter. This is one static assembly, not a functioning heating, spinning or food-processing design. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.670 × 0.445 × 0.670 m; 9,400 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
